relationships.subject: 4Q3C
relationships.evidence_quote: A selective CB2 receptor agonist, 4-quinolone-3-carboxyamide (4Q3C), significantly inhibited the mechanosensitivity of mucosal bladder afferents to stroking.

relationships.subject: methanandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: potentiated the mechanosensitivity of mucosal bladder afferents in response to stroking

key_findings: CB2 agonist 4Q3C selectively inhibited mechanosensitivity of mucosal but not muscular-mucosal bladder afferents; effect lost with CB2 antagonist.
